CSV TOWN FLAG: temple is at Kaleshwaram village, Mahadevpur mandal, Jayashankar Bhupalpally district, at the Godavari-Pranahita Triveni Sangamam - not in Ramagundam. Unique feature: two lingas (Shiva as Mukteswara, Yama as Kaleshwara) share a single pedestal; the Mukteswara linga has two 'nostrils' into which poured water disappears and is believed to merge with the Godavari. One of the Trilinga Kshetrams. Daily darshan 4:30 AM-1:00 PM and 4:00 PM-8:00 PM (yatradham.org). Duplicate file written per spec; recommend merging or dropping this row.

name: Kaleshwara Mukteswara Swamy Temple
town: Kaleshwaram (CSV town 'Ramagundam' is WRONG - the temple is at Kaleshwaram village in Jayashankar Bhupalpally district; Ramagundam is only its nearest railway station, ~71-115 km away)
town_description: Kaleshwaram is an ancient pilgrimage village in Jayashankar Bhupalpally district (Mahadevpur postal area) at the exact merging point of the Pranahita into the Godavari - the Triveni Sangamam (Dakshina Gangotri), near the Telangana-Maharashtra-Chhattisgarh trijunction. One of the Trilinga Kshetrams, it sits about 277 km from Hyderabad and draws pilgrims during Karthika Month and Pushkarams.

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad - about 288-291 km.
travel.railway: Ramagundam railway station - about 71-115 km (nearest railhead); buses run Ramagundam-Kaleshwaram.
travel.road: About 500 m from Kaleshwaram bus stand; regular TSRTC buses from Warangal, Karimnagar, Manthani, Hanamkonda, Ramagundam and Godavarikhani depots.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Karthika Month (Nov 16-Dec 15) for holy baths; Pushkarams every 12 years.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 4:30 AM-1:00 PM and 4:00 PM-8:00 PM daily (verify on festival days).
